scripts.build: npx tsx scripts/publish-all.ts --if-empty && npx tsx scripts/validate-content.ts && npx tsx scripts/generate-sitemap.ts && tsc -b && vite build
scripts.build:static: npx tsx scripts/validate-content.ts && npx tsx scripts/generate-sitemap.ts && tsc -b && vite build
scripts.ci:check: node --test "shared/**/*.test.js" && node scripts/check-boundaries.mjs && node scripts/check-api-routes.mjs && npx tsx scripts/validate-content.ts && npx tsx scripts/generate-sitemap.ts && tsc -b && vite build
scripts.docker:seed: docker compose exec soma npx tsx scripts/init-docker.ts
scripts.deploy:fly:launch: fly launch --no-deploy && fly volumes create soma_data --region iad --size 1 || true && fly deploy
scripts.deploy:render: echo 'Render deploys from GitHub via render.yaml — push to main or deploy via Render dashboard (Docker + Disk at /app/data)'
scripts.deploy:netlify: npm run build:static && netlify deploy --prod --dir dist --functions netlify/functions
scripts.deploy:netlify:draft: npm run build:static && netlify deploy --dir dist --functions netlify/functions
scripts.deploy:cloudflare: npm run build:static && wrangler pages deploy dist --project-name soma
scripts.deploy:cloudflare:preview: npm run build:static && wrangler pages deploy dist --project-name soma --branch preview
scripts.deploy:all:check: npm run ci:check && docker compose config --quiet && echo 'All deploy configs valid'
